# Profitable Agent Stack

> Cost-first directory of AI GTM tools ranked by use-case fit, published price and user sentiment, with estimated monthly stack costs by company stage. Prices checked 2026-10-26; verify with vendors. Not advice.

## Key pages
- [Solo founder monetizing an idea](https://profitableagentstack.com/stages/solo-founder.html): est. $68/mo stack
- [Pre-seed to Series A, growing](https://profitableagentstack.com/stages/pre-seed-to-series-a.html): est. $448/mo stack
- [Later stage, 10+ people](https://profitableagentstack.com/stages/later-stage.html): est. $4,145/mo stack

## Tools
- Instantly (Outbound email / sequencing; stages: solo, growth, later): Outreach Growth $47/mo, Hypergrowth $358/mo; Credits Growth $47/mo (1,500 credits). Value score: 94. Source: https://instantly.ai/pricing
- Smartlead (Outbound email / sequencing; stages: solo, growth): Base from $39/mo (pricing page also lists Pro, Smart, Prime tiers). Value score: 88. Source: https://www.smartlead.ai/pricing
- Exa (List building & lead data; stages: solo, growth): Free $10 credits/mo; Search from $4 per 1k requests (usage-based). Value score: 88. Source: https://exa.ai/pricing
- Hunter (Enrichment & verification; stages: solo, growth, later): Free (50 credits); Starter $49/mo monthly ($34 annual); Growth $149 ($104); Scale $299 ($209). Value score: 88. Source: https://hunter.io/pricing
- FullEnrich (Enrichment & verification; stages: growth, later): Free trial; Pro 15K credits $720/mo; other credit tiers on page. Value score: 88. Source: https://fullenrich.com/pricing
- Waalaxy (LinkedIn outreach; stages: solo, growth): €19, €49, €69 per user/mo; 14-day free trial (EUR). Value score: 88. Source: https://www.waalaxy.com/pricing
- HeyGen (Launch, content & social; stages: solo, growth, later): Free $0; Creator $29/mo; Pro $49/mo; Business $149/mo. Value score: 88. Source: https://www.heygen.com/pricing
- RB2B (Signals, intent & analytics; stages: solo, growth): Free $0; Starter $79/mo; Pro from $149; Pro+ from $199. Value score: 88. Source: https://www.rb2b.com/pricing
- PostHog (Signals, intent & analytics; stages: solo, growth, later): Free monthly allowance (e.g. 1M analytics events), then usage-based. Value score: 88. Source: https://posthog.com/pricing
- HeyReach (LinkedIn outreach; stages: growth, later): Growth $79/sender/mo; Agency $999/mo (25 senders); Unlimited $2,999/mo. Value score: 83. Source: https://www.heyreach.io/pricing
- Salesforge (Outbound email / sequencing; stages: solo, growth): Page title says 'Starting at $48/mo'; plan subscriptions shown at $40 and $80/mo billed monthly. Value score: 81. Source: https://www.salesforge.ai/pricing
- Reply.io (Outbound email / sequencing; stages: growth, later): Email volume tiers 'starts from' $59 monthly (lower with annual); LinkedIn add-on $69/mo/acct; higher tiers vary. Value score: 72. Source: https://reply.io/pricing/
- lemlist (Outbound email / sequencing; stages: growth, later): Email $69/mo monthly ($55 annual), 50,000 emails/mo; Multichannel $109/mo ($87 annual). Value score: 65. Source: https://www.lemlist.com/pricing
- Expandi (LinkedIn outreach; stages: solo, growth): $99/mo monthly ($79 annual), 7-day free trial. Value score: 65. Source: https://expandi.io/pricing/
- Postiz (Launch, content & social; stages: solo, growth, later): Standard $29/mo, Team $39, Pro $49, Ultimate $99. Value score: 65. Source: https://postiz.com/pricing
- Common Room (Signals, intent & analytics; stages: later): Essential $2,500/mo billed annually (5 seats). Value score: 65. Source: https://www.commonroom.io/pricing
- Woodpecker (Outbound email / sequencing; stages: solo, growth): Price not captured automatically — see vendor page. Value score: None. Source: https://woodpecker.co/pricing/
- Apollo (List building & lead data; stages: growth, later): Price not captured automatically — see vendor page. Value score: None. Source: https://www.apollo.io/pricing
- Clay (Enrichment & verification; stages: growth, later): Usage-based on actions; page shows e.g. 15K actions/mo at $60/mo and a plan at $167/mo — check tier details. Value score: None. Source: https://www.clay.com/pricing
- Clearout (Enrichment & verification; stages: solo, growth): Price not captured automatically — see vendor page. Value score: None. Source: https://clearout.io/pricing/
- 11x (AI SDR / agentic SDR; stages: later): Contact sales. Value score: None. Source: https://www.11x.ai/
- Artisan (AI SDR / agentic SDR; stages: growth, later): Contact sales. Value score: None. Source: https://www.artisan.co/pricing

## Stage stacks (estimates)
### Solo founder monetizing an idea: $68/mo + €19 Waalaxy
Assumptions: 1 person, 1 LinkedIn account, ~5,000 emails/mo, monthly billing, entry tiers.
- Outbound email / sequencing: Smartlead, Base, 1 workspace, $39
- Enrichment & verification: Hunter, Free plan (50 credits), $0
- List building & lead data: Exa, Free $10 credits/mo, $0
- LinkedIn outreach: Waalaxy, 1 user × €19 (EUR, not converted), $0
- Launch, content & social: Postiz, Standard, $29
- Signals, intent & analytics: PostHog, Free allowance, $0
- Signals, intent & analytics: RB2B, Free plan, $0
### Pre-seed to Series A, growing: $448/mo 
Assumptions: 3 people, 2 LinkedIn senders, ~5,000 emails/mo plus 1,500 lead credits, monthly billing.
- Outbound email / sequencing: Instantly, Outreach Growth, $47
- List building & lead data: Instantly, Credits Growth (1,500 credits), $47
- Enrichment & verification: Hunter, Starter, $49
- LinkedIn outreach: HeyReach, Growth $79 × 2 senders, $158
- Launch, content & social: Postiz, Team, $39
- Launch, content & social: HeyGen, Creator, $29
- Signals, intent & analytics: RB2B, Starter, $79
- Signals, intent & analytics: PostHog, Free allowance, $0
- AI SDR / agentic SDR: Artisan, Optional — contact sales, not included, $0
### Later stage, 10+ people: $4,145/mo 
Assumptions: 10+ people, 10 LinkedIn senders, high email volume, monthly list prices except Common Room (billed annually).
- Outbound email / sequencing: Instantly, Outreach Hypergrowth, $358
- Enrichment & verification: Hunter, Scale, $299
- LinkedIn outreach: HeyReach, Growth $79 × 10 senders, $790
- Launch, content & social: Postiz, Pro, $49
- Launch, content & social: HeyGen, Business, $149
- Signals, intent & analytics: Common Room, Essential (billed annually, 5 seats), $2500
- AI SDR / agentic SDR: 11x / Qualified, Contact sales, not included, $0

## Methodology
Value = 50% fit (editorial) + 30% cost + 20% sentiment; sentiment not yet verified so fit/cost reweighted 62.5/37.5.

## Disclaimer
Profitable Agent Stack is for general information only, provided "as is" without warranties. Prices, plans, features and review data change often and may be inaccurate or out of date (last checked 2026-10-26); always verify with the vendor. Cost estimates and scores are editorial estimates, not advice. Nothing here is professional, legal or financial advice. Trademarks belong to their owners; listing is not endorsement. Some links may be affiliate or sponsored — see our Disclosure.
